Negotiated hospital prices · February 2024

Same city, same surgery, very different prices

Insurers and hospitals negotiate a separate price for every procedure. Pick a market and a procedure to see what each local hospital is paid, from the price files insurers must now publish.

Hospital's average price across insurers Lowest to highest insurer U.S. median

What the prices are. Facility prices from the Transparency in Coverage files of UnitedHealthcare, the Blue Cross Blue Shield plans and Cigna, February 2024. Hip/knee replacement is MS-DRG 470, cesarean delivery DRG 788, vaginal delivery DRG 807, PCI a drug-eluting stent without complications (DRG 247/322); colonoscopy and lower-limb MRI are outpatient facility fees. Each insurer's price is its median across its networks; the dot is the average over insurers.

Markets are hospital referral regions (Dartmouth Atlas), shown when at least four hospitals have a price. Posted rates are contract prices, not what patients pay out of pocket.

From “Hospitals, Insurers, and the Variation in Negotiated Prices: Evidence from Transparency in Coverage Data,” Dalya Elmalt.
